sources.name: Handelsregister (Gemeinsames Registerportal der Länder)
sources.verdict: Verified live (fetch OK, portal warns of load spikes); free search since DiRUG 2022 incl. document retrieval, but NO official open API or bulk export — machine route is careful form-driven retrieval; structured XML register data only via the paid Registerdatenübermittlung channel. Yield: all ~5M+ German registered entities.

sources.name: Unternehmensregister
sources.verdict: Verified live; central platform aggregating register entries, financial statements (Bilanz-Navigator), capital-market disclosures, BRIS-connected; no public bulk API found — per-company retrieval route. High yield for financial-statement provenance.

sources.name: OffeneRegister.de (Open Knowledge Foundation Handelsregister dump)
sources.verdict: Not re-fetched this session but well-known: full SQLite dump + API of ~5M Handelsregister records; snapshot is from 2019 so use only for backfill/ID seeding, never as current truth.

sources.name: Transparenzregister (UBO register)
sources.verdict: Real register but public access is restricted post-2022 ECJ ruling (account + legitimate-interest fee per extract); listed for honesty — not a bulk machine route, consistent with project rule to never assume open UBO data.

sources.name: Handelsregisterbekanntmachungen (register announcements)
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified this session; long-standing official announcement search (new registrations, changes, deletions) with date/court-filtered result pages — the standard machine route for daily incorporation/change signals (what startupdetector builds on).

sources.name: Bundesanzeiger (Federal Gazette)
sources.verdict: Verified live; publishes annual accounts, capital-market announcements, net short positions, company/court notices — but search is session-based with bot protection and full-text search restricted, so machine access needs careful session handling; highest-value filing gazette in DE.

sources.name: Insolvenzbekanntmachungen.de (insolvency court announcements)
sources.verdict: Verified live; official portal of all German insolvency courts with search; results deleted after short statutory windows so continuous polling is required — core NPL/distressed signal source.

sources.name: BaFin company database (InstInfo — banks, AIFMs/KVGen, investment firms, payment/crypto licensees)
sources.verdict: Fetch failed with header/WAF error (confirms known WAF issues); the authoritative register of every BaFin-licensed institution incl. KVGs/AIFMs — route is browser-grade client with session cookies; per-license-type enumeration possible once past WAF. Essential.

sources.name: BaFin investment funds database (FondsInfo)
sources.verdict: Not separately fetched; same MVP portal (same WAF caveat); registers German investment funds incl. Spezial-AIFs by KVG — the fund-level complement to InstInfo.

sources.name: BaFin MiCA/crypto authorisation route (crypto custody + MiCA CASPs within BaFin registers)
sources.verdict: Databases overview page is the stable entry; MiCA CASP/crypto-custody licensees surface through the InstInfo database (same WAF); cross-check via ESMA's MiCA register for the DE subset.

sources.name: Deutsche Bundesbank (statistics API + bank directories)
sources.verdict: Not re-verified this session but stable: open statistics web service (api.statistiken.bundesbank.de), downloadable bank sort-code (Bankleitzahlen) files and MFI lists — deterministic $0 route for the German banking universe.

sources.name: BaFin pension/insurance supervision registers (Pensionskassen, Pensionsfonds, insurers via InstInfo)
sources.verdict: Germany has no separate pension regulator — the LP side (insurers, Pensionskassen, Pensionsfonds, Versorgungswerke are state-level) enumerates from InstInfo by institution type; same WAF caveat.

sources.name: Deutsche Börse Cash Market — all tradable instruments (T7/Xetra CSV)
sources.verdict: Verified: page confirmed offering 'T7 (Xetra) Alle handelbaren Instrumente' CSV download — clean deterministic issuer/instrument feed.

sources.name: Börse Frankfurt issuer/instrument directory
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; Angular front end backed by an undocumented JSON API (api.boerse-frankfurt.de) — usable but fragile; prefer the Cash Market CSV above for lists.

sources.name: EEX (European Energy Exchange) trading participants
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; EEX publishes trading-participant lists and market data — relevant to energy/carbon alternatives; verify exact list URL before adapter work.

sources.name: BVK — Bundesverband Beteiligungskapital member directory
sources.verdict: Verified via homepage fetch (public Mitglieder section confirmed); the canonical German PE/VC GP directory plus industry statistics PDFs.

sources.name: BAI — Bundesverband Alternative Investments member list
sources.verdict: Member-list URL confirmed via search (direct guess-URL 404ed earlier — this is the right path); 200+ members across liquid/illiquid alternatives, placement agents, service providers — maps almost 1:1 onto the project taxonomy.

sources.name: BKS — Bundesvereinigung Kreditankauf und Servicing member list (NPL)
sources.verdict: Verified via search (member page exists; apex domain, not www); the German NPL investor + servicer association — direct feed for Private Debt/NPL entity sourcing.

sources.name: BVI — German Investment Funds Association member directory
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; BVI publishes member lists (KVGs, custodians) and fund statistics — good for the ManCo/fund-admin service graph.

sources.name: Startup-Verband (German Startups Association) members
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; membership skews startups/ecosystem rather than investors — secondary source for venture-studio/startup entities.

sources.name: Bankenverband (Association of German Banks) member list
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; private-bank member list published on site; overlaps Bundesbank/BaFin registers but adds classification signal.

sources.name: BVR — cooperative banks association
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; publishes the full list of ~670 Volksbanken/Raiffeisenbanken with annual figures — deterministic download historically available.

sources.name: DSGV — savings banks association (Sparkassen directory)
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; Sparkassen ranking/directory published annually — LP-adjacent and lender-side coverage.

sources.name: vdp — Association of German Pfandbrief Banks member list
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; member list of Pfandbrief issuers = the real-estate-debt lender universe; also publishes property-price indices.

sources.name: BDL — Bundesverband Deutscher Leasing-Unternehmen
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; leasing-company member directory — asset-backed/specialty-finance entity source; confirm exact domain before adapter.

sources.name: Deutscher Factoring-Verband member list
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; member list of German factoring houses — trade/supply-chain finance coverage.

sources.name: GDV — German Insurance Association
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified (association, not regulator — categorized here for the LP side); member insurers list + statistics; insurers are Germany's largest alternatives LPs.

sources.name: aba — Arbeitsgemeinschaft für betriebliche Altersversorgung (occupational pensions)
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; occupational-pension association — route into Pensionskassen/CTA universe (LP side); member visibility partial.

sources.name: ZIA — Zentraler Immobilien Ausschuss (real estate industry association)
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; umbrella association of German real estate (developers, managers, funds) with member list — Real Assets category sourcing.

sources.name: VID — Verband Insolvenzverwalter und Sachwalter Deutschlands member directory
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; searchable directory of German insolvency practitioners — service-graph + distressed coverage; complement with court appointment announcements.

sources.name: Bundesweites Amtliches Anwaltsverzeichnis (official lawyer register, BRAK)
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; official nationwide lawyer search maintained by BRAK — use for verifying law-firm entities, not bulk harvesting (no personal-data-at-scale per project law).

sources.name: RICS Germany — find a member / regulated firms
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; RICS global directory filters to Germany for accredited valuers/firms — Real Assets service graph; likely JS-heavy.

sources.name: KfW Group
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified this session; national promotional bank — press/reporting on fund commitments and programs; KfW is a major German VC/PE LP.

sources.name: KfW Capital (fund-of-funds arm)
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; publishes its VC fund portfolio/commitments — direct public evidence of German fund closings and LP-GP edges.

sources.name: Germany Trade & Invest (GTAI)
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; investment-promotion agency — sector reports and FDI signals; low entity yield, useful context feed.

sources.name: BImA — Bundesanstalt für Immobilienaufgaben (federal real estate sales)
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified; federal property agency publishes sale offers of state real estate — niche but genuine real-assets deal-flow signal (closest DE analog to a privatization agency).

sources.name: DEHSt — German Emissions Trading Authority (EU ETS national administrator)
sources.verdict: Verified live; administers EU-ETS 1/2, nEHS, CBAM for Germany; publishes installation/allocation lists as downloads — the DE carbon-accounts route for Niche Alts.

sources.name: Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR, Bundesnetzagentur energy master data)
sources.verdict: Verified live with public-data portal AND full bulk download (plus webservice API); every German generation unit + market participant — outstanding $0 deterministic source for renewables/energy-transition real assets.

sources.name: Datenservice Öffentlicher Einkauf / oeffentlichevergabe.de (public procurement)
sources.verdict: Verified: central federal/state/municipal notice service with documented open-data API in eForms-DE, OCDS and CSV (swagger at /documentation/swagger-ui/opendata/) — infrastructure/concession deal signals at $0.

sources.name: GovData — German open data portal
sources.verdict: Not re-verified this session; CKAN-based catalog with API — discovery layer for state-level registers and datasets rather than a primary source.

sources.name: GLEIF LEI Golden Copy (DE subset)
sources.verdict: Not re-verified this session; free bulk files + API; filter country=DE for ~150k+ German LEIs with register IDs — best free entity-resolution spine linking Handelsregister numbers to financial entities.

sources.name: Handelsblatt (Schlagzeilen feed)

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong on German GPs/LPs, fund closings, AIFM landscape; weak on sub-institutional/mid-cap and the service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: BaFin InstInfo/FondsInfo AIFM and fund registers; Bundesanzeiger fund/company filings; association statistics (BVK, BAI, Invest Europe) — all directly accessible above.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deep German deal/valuation coverage for PE/VC and M&A; advisor networks well mapped.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Handelsregister filings and Handelsregisterbekanntmachungen (cap-table/UBO changes), Bundesanzeiger accounts, press (Handelsblatt/FINANCE/JUVE deal reports) — the same gazette+press stack we catalog.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: German startup/scaleup universe with government/eco-system partnerships; good funding-round recall, weaker on debt/real assets.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Handelsregister new incorporations, startup press (deutsche-startups, Gründerszene, Startbase), association data (Startup-Verband) — all public routes listed.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow DE coverage, self-reported profiles plus press-sourced rounds.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases and startup media; little registry grounding — our registry-first approach out-depths it structurally.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The benchmark local player: company graph, financials, register-event timeline for all German entities; no alternatives-specific classification.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Proves exactly which public sources are machine-usable at scale: Handelsregister + register announcements, Bundesanzeiger annual accounts, Insolvenzbekanntmachungen — go to these directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Weekly German startup funding/incorporation reports sold to VCs.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Built almost entirely on Handelsregisterbekanntmachungen (new GmbH/UG registrations, capital increases) — confirms that announcement stream alone yields funding signals pre-press.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Credit data on the full German company universe; payment behavior is proprietary.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Handelsregister, Bundesanzeiger financial statements, insolvency announcements — plus proprietary field data we don't need.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Structured German financials + ownership; standard in corporate finance.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Bundesanzeiger/Unternehmensregister accounts (largely via Creditreform sourcing) and register data — same public originals we ingest.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: German VC/banking market statistics frequently cited by press.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Bundesbank statistics, Bundesanzeiger filings, KfW/association data — assembled from the public stack, showing the analysis layer is buildable at $0 data cost.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: German-speaking PE/M&A transaction lists and newsletters; strong mid-cap recall.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases, advisor submissions, JUVE/FINANCE reporting — signals-press tier, no registry moat.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but genuinely not found/confirmed: (1) any official open-data bulk API for the Handelsregister — free web search exists since 2022 but structured XML register data is only available via the paid Registerdatenübermittlung channel; the 2019 OffeneRegister dump is the only free bulk artifact. (2) A working RSS feed for FINANCE Magazin, Börsen-Zeitung, finanz-szene.de (/feed returned 500), private-banking-magazin and dasinvestment (/feed 404) — these must be index-parsed. (3) Direct fetch verification of BaFin's MVP portal (WAF/header error, consistent with known issues), manager-magazin and FAZ RSS (bot-blocked here though feed URLs are documented elsewhere), and finance-magazin.de entirely. (4) A dedicated public register of fund administrators separate from BaFin's InstInfo — none exists; fund-admin licensees only enumerate via BaFin institution-type filters. (5) A German national privatization agency in the CEE sense — closest analogs listed are BImA (federal real estate) and GTAI. (6) Börse Stuttgart/regional exchange issuer lists and INDat (insolvency trade press) were considered but not verified, so they were left out rather than padded in.
